title: Turing, Computing Machinery and Intelligence

title: Dartmouth research proposal

title: ALPAC, Language and Machines
claim: Report distinguishes reduced short-term translation support from sustained computational-linguistics funding; July1966 introductory letter explicitly guards against wholesale termination.

title: Minsky and Papert, Perceptrons
claim: 1969 book by Minsky and Papert.
note: Its limitations concern studied perceptron classes; do not generalize to all neural networks or sole cause of winter.
proposed_korean: 민스키와 페퍼트는 당시 퍼셉트론 구조의 한계를 분석했어요. 모든 신경망이 불가능하다는 뜻은 아니었어요.

title: Rumelhart, Hinton, Williams, Learning representations by back-propagating errors
claim: All three authors popularized multilayer representation learning with backpropagation.
note: Avoid sole-invention claim and claim all deep-network training obstacles solved in 1986. Author/date/abstract page inspected; not a full technical replication or full-paper review.
proposed_korean: 루멜하트와 힌튼, 윌리엄스는 여러 층의 연결을 조정해 내부 표현을 학습시키는 방법을 널리 알렸어요. 더 깊은 신경망을 안정적으로 가르치는 문제는 뒤에도 남았어요.

title: Werbos, Backpropagation: past and future
claim: Werbos discusses his 1974 Harvard dissertation as a neural-network backpropagation precursor.
note: Do not elevate author priority claim into uncontested sole invention; use an early contribution. Verified relevant indexed source excerpt; full text not inspected.
